summary: Resolved the OPEN question from wpcvw-spell-action.json: which character-record bytes hold a character's LEARNED/KNOWN spells, and how the camp/character-view SPELL viewer (wpcvw_show_spellbook @ wpcvw 0x32a6, MODE==0 read-only) reads them. ANSWER: the known-spell store is a BITSET at record +0x188 (abs DGROUP 0x4570 for slot 0; slot N at 0x1b0*N + 0x4570) — this is the field the schema currently calls `spellSlotsKnown` (mis-described as a per-school count array; it is actually a flat per-spell-id bitset). Indexing: spell index i (0..0x51, the 82-entry spell-table index, base DGROUP+0xde stride 6) -> byte (i>>3) within the field, bit (i&7). 82 spells need ceil(82/8)=11 bytes; the field is 20 bytes wide so bytes 11..19 (covering nominal indices 88..159) are spare/unused for the stock roster. The per-school sublist builder wpcvw 0x318a loops all 82 spell-table entries, keeps an entry iff (a) its school byte [bx+0xde]==selected-school AND (b) the bitset membership test (wroot 0x2aaf, reached via thunk 0xe34b) returns 1 for that index against the +0x4570 bitset. The membership routine is a pure (idx>>3)/(1<<(idx&7)) bit test — NOT a 12-byte linked-list walk (it shares the thunk slot 0xe34b with the creation picker's list test, but the wpcvw caller passes a raw byte-array base, so against +0x4570 it behaves as a bitset). LIVE/DATA VERIFICATION: decoded +0x188 directly from the pinned test-fixtures pcfile.dbs for all 6 stock chars: THESUS/TEMPEST (Fighters) and LYSANDR (Thief) = all-zero (no known spells); TREON (Mage) bits {0,48} = Fire-L1 + Mental-L1 (both Mage-book); PENTAG (Mage) bits {9,37} = Water-L1 + Earth-L1 (both Mage-book); NOBAL (Priest) bits {50,64} = Mental-L1 + Divine-L1 (both Priest-book). Every set bit decodes to a level-1 spell in the character's own book — exactly the creation grant. COST/POWER source: the per-spell COST shown in the sublist is the spell-table cost byte entry+0x2 (== [bx+0xe0] where bx=idx*6), read at wpcvw 0x3811 into [bp-0x42]; affordability is mana_by_school (record +0x4410, indexed by school) compared to that cost (wpcvw 0x383c..0x3843) — affordable spells highlighted via the highlight printer thunk 0xdf85, unaffordable via 0xc041. In MODE==0 (camp/combat browse) the cost-deduction core in FUN_416d is skipped entirely, so the viewer is genuinely read-only.
method: (a) Linear disasm via `ndisasm -b 16 -k 0,<file_off>` of original/wpcvw.ovr at the show_spellbook picker (0x32a6) and its two helpers: the per-school known-spell list builder (0x318a) and the sublist renderer (0x31e5). (b) Resolved the membership thunk 0xe34b via the cross-overlay thunk-delta law (0xe34b - 0xba9c = wroot image 0x28af; + 0x200 MZ = wroot file 0x2aaf) and disassembled wroot 0x2aaf -> a (bx>>3)/(test [bx+si],1<<(bx&7)) bitset test. (c) Cross-checked the 0x982f function the prior finding cited as 'spell-known check' -> it is actually the SKILLS render (compares record +0x451c/+0x4526/+0x452d skill bytes), NOT spells; corrected. (d) Decoded the +0x188 bitset for all 6 stock records straight from test-fixtures/original/pcfile.dbs (24-byte header + 16x432-byte records; slot N at file 0x18 + N*0x1b0; field at record +0x188) and mapped each set bit to packages/data/src/character-creation/spell-table.ts (school/level/cost/book-mask). (e) Located the cost read (0x3811 [bx+0xe0]) and the mana_by_school affordability compare (0x383c [bx+0x4410] vs cost).
wpcvw_runtime_delta_used: 0x4564 (file_offset = CS_offset - 0x4564); not needed for the new findings (all addresses are direct file offsets read via ndisasm origin-0 listing) except to confirm continuity with wpcvw-spell-action.json.

findings.claim: A character's LEARNED/KNOWN spells are stored as a flat per-spell-id BITSET at character-record offset +0x188 (in-memory abs 0x4570 for slot 0; slot N base = 0x1b0*N + 0x4570; on-disk pcfile.dbs at record +0x188). Indexing: spell-table index i (0..0x51, i.e. 0..81, the same 82-entry table at DGROUP+0xde stride 6) is KNOWN iff bit (i & 7) of byte (i >> 3) of the field is set. 82 spells require 11 bytes; the field is declared 20 bytes wide (+0x188..+0x19b) so the upper 9 bytes are spare for the stock roster. This is the field the schema currently calls `spellSlotsKnown` and describes (incorrectly) as a per-school count array — it is a bitset, and a TS decoder lists known spells by: for i in 0..81: if (field[i>>3] >> (i&7)) & 1 -> spell i is known; group by spell-table school for the per-school view.

evidence.details: wpcvw 0x318a (per-school list builder, called from show_spellbook 0x34fd with args [bp+4]=slot, [bp+6]=school, [bp+8]=out-buffer): loops si=0..0x51 (0x31d7 cmp si,0x52; jl). At 0x31a6 al=[bx+0xde] (bx=si*6) = spell-table school byte; cmp [bp+0x6] (selected school) jnz skip. If school matches: 0x31b2 ax=0x1b0*[bp+0x4](slot); 0x31b8 add ax,0x4570 -> the per-character bitset base; push (base), push si(spell idx); 0x31bc call 0xe34b; cmp ax,1; if 1 append si to out-buffer [bp+8]. The 0x4570 immediate (record +0x188) is the literal known-spell field base. 0xe34b -> wroot 0x2aaf (thunk delta) is a pure bit test (see known-spell-membership-bittest). The decoded +0x188 bytes for all 6 stock records confirm the encoding (see known-spell-live-roster-verification).
evidence.comparator_note: Loop bound `cmp si,0x52; jl` = indices 0..0x51 (82), high confidence. School compare is `jnz skip` (equality), unambiguous.

findings.claim: The membership routine reached via thunk 0xe34b (wroot file 0x2aaf) is a BITSET test, not a list walk. Given base pointer si=[bp+4] and bit index bx=[bp+6]: byteOffset = bx>>3, bitMask = 1<<(bx&7), returns 1 iff test [si+byteOffset] & bitMask is nonzero, else 0. So `0xe34b(record+0x4570, spell_idx)` returns whether bit `spell_idx` is set in the +0x188 known-spell field. (Note: this same thunk slot 0xe34b is used by the wpcmk creation picker against its master-eligible structure at DGROUP 0x55f8 — there it behaves as a membership test over a bit-addressed structure too; the wpcvw caller points it at the per-character +0x4570 field.)

evidence.details: wroot 0x2aaf: si=[bp+4](base); bx=[bp+6](idx); dx=bx; cl=3; shr bx,cl (bx=idx/8); cx=7; and cx,dx (cx=idx&7); al=1; shl al,cl (al=1<<(idx&7)); test [bx+si],al; jz -> return 0; else return 1. Reached from wpcvw 0x31bc `call 0xe34b`; thunk delta 0xe34b-0xba9c=image 0x28af, +0x200 = file 0x2aaf. The immediately-following routine at wroot 0x2ada is a multi-bit/range variant (mul + shr) used elsewhere; the single-bit test at 0x2aaf is the one wpcvw's spellbook calls.
evidence.comparator_note: shr by 3 / and 7 / 1<<n is the canonical bit-index decomposition; high confidence.

findings.claim: Decoding the +0x188 bitset directly from the pinned test-fixtures pcfile.dbs (24-byte header + 16x432-byte records; slot N at file 0x18 + N*0x1b0) yields, for all 6 stock chars: THESUS(Fighter)=all-zero, TEMPEST(Fighter)=all-zero, LYSANDR(Thief)=all-zero, NOBAL(Priest)=bits{50,64}, TREON(Mage)=bits{0,48}, PENTAG(Mage)=bits{9,37}. Mapping each set bit to spell-table.ts: TREON{0=Fire-L1,48=Mental-L1} both Mage-book; PENTAG{9=Water-L1,37=Earth-L1} both Mage-book; NOBAL{50=Mental-L1,64=Divine-L1} both Priest-book. Every set bit is a level-1 spell in the character's own spellbook — consistent with the creation grant (level cap 1) and confirming the bitset interpretation. Non-casters have an empty bitset (the camp SPELL viewer would show all schools' sublists blank for them).

evidence.details: Raw +0x188 hex (20 bytes): TREON='0100000000000100...' -> bits 0,48; PENTAG='0002000020000000...' -> bits 9,37; NOBAL='0000000000000400010000...' -> bits 50,64; THESUS/TEMPEST/LYSANDR all-zero. Bit i = byte(i>>3) bit(i&7). Spell-table cross-ref via packages/data/src/character-creation/spell-table.ts RAW (entry=[school,level,cost,b3,b4,byte5], byte5 book mask bit3=Mage bit2=Priest bit1=Psionic bit0=Alchemist): idx0 byte5=0x8(Mage), idx48 byte5=0xb(Mage+...), idx9 byte5=0x8(Mage), idx37 byte5=0x8(Mage), idx50 byte5=0x7(Priest+...), idx64 byte5=0x7(Priest+...). These match the prior wpcfile-dbs.json/starter-spells.json stock values (TREON +0x188 leading bytes 01 00 .. 01, PENTAG 00 02 .. 20) — same field, now decoded.
evidence.comparator_note: n/a — direct byte read of committed fixture.

findings.claim: wpcvw_show_spellbook (0x32a6) renders the SPELL viewer in two levels and reads the known-spell bitset only at the school drill-down. Level 1 (school grid): renders the 6 school cells (3x2). Level 2 (ENTER on a school): calls the list builder 0x318a(slot, schoolCell, outBuf=[bp-0x32]) which produces the array of KNOWN spell-table indices whose school == the selected cell (filtered by the +0x4570 bitset membership test), returning the count into [bp-0xa]; then calls the renderer 0x31e5 which prints each listed spell's NAME via msg id = (spell_table_index) + 0xfa0 (spell name table base 3984) at 0x3252. So 'which spells appear in a school's sublist' = known(bit set in +0x188) AND school-matches; 'per-spell whether known' is answered before listing (only known spells are ever added to the buffer — the viewer does not list unknown spells greyed-out, it omits them).

evidence.details: show_spellbook 0x34f6: lea ax,[bp-0x32](outBuf); push; push [bp-0x40](school cell); push [bp+0x8](slot); 0x3500 call 0x318a; mov [bp-0xa],ax (count). 0x3509: push outBuf; push count; push 0,0; push school; push slot; push window [bp-0x4]; 0x351e call 0x31e5 (renderer). In 0x31e5 0x324d: di=([bp+0xa]+si); bx=[bp+0x10](outBuf); ax=[bx+di](spell idx); 0x3252 add ax,0xfa0; call 0xc2db (print msg). Name msg base 0xfa0=3984 matches wpcvw-spell-action.json's 'msg id = spell_idx + 4000' (4000=0xfa0). School-cell labels use a different base 0xf6e (0x34d3) — that is the school NAME, not spell name.
evidence.comparator_note: Per-school filter is the school-equality test inside 0x318a (0x31ac jnz skip) AND the bitset membership (0x31c2 cmp ax,1 jnz skip); both must pass.

findings.claim: The per-spell COST shown in the viewer's sublist is the spell-table COST byte = entry+0x2 (in DGROUP terms [bx+0xe0] where bx = spell_table_idx*6), read at wpcvw 0x3811 into [bp-0x42]. The SAME byte the creation picker shows as COST. Affordability coloring compares the caster's per-school mana pool mana_by_school (record +0x4410, indexed school*4) against that cost at 0x383c..0x3843: if mana < cost the spell name is printed via the highlight/affordable printer thunk 0xdf85 (0x3854), else via 0xc041 (0x3874) — i.e. the picker tints by affordability but (per wpcvw-spell-action.json fun-416d-cost-and-cast) never blocks selection. In MODE==0 (camp/combat read-only browse) FUN_416d skips the cost-deduction block entirely, so no mana/HP is spent — the viewer is purely informational. There is no separate 'power' value sourced from the record for the browse view; the power-level word *0x578a is initialized (0x11 at 0x3542 / 0 at 0x3717) for the interactive cast path and is not a known-spell record field.

evidence.details: 0x3804 ax=[bx-0x32] (spell idx from outBuf via [bp-0x3a] index); 0x3809 bx=idx*6; 0x3811 al=[bx+0xe0] (cost byte); 0x3817 mov [bp-0x42],ax (cost). 0x382b ax=0x1b0*[bp+0x8](slot); 0x3831 cx=[bp-0x40](school)<<2; add -> bx; 0x383c ax=[bx+0x4410] (mana_by_school[school]); 0x3840 cmp ax,[bp-0x42]; jnl 0x385f. <-cost path (0x3845): call 0xdf85 (highlight). >=cost path (0x385f): push cost [bp-0x42]; call 0xc041. Cross-ref spell-picker-eligibility.json nav-two-level-mode-and-cost: COST == spell-table b2/cost byte (creation picker), empirically matched (ENERGY BLAST=2 etc.). The cost byte is entry+0x2 = [bx+0xe0] (table base +0xde, so +0xe0 = +0x2 within entry).
evidence.comparator_note: Affordability compare `cmp mana,cost; jnl` (skip-highlight if mana>=cost): the highlight (0xdf85) path is taken when mana<cost. Mark MEDIUM on the exact highlight-vs-normal semantics (which color means affordable) — the branch direction is clear but the visual meaning should be eyeballed against the engine framebuffer.

findings.claim: CORRECTION to wpcvw-spell-action.json (castable-filter-known-and-in-table) and character-record-spells-and-gaps.json (no-spell-bitmaps): the claim that 'spell knowledge is read per-byte at wpcvw 0x982f' is WRONG. wpcvw 0x982f is the SKILLS-page render helper — it walks a name buffer ([bp+6]/[bp+8]/[bp+0xa]/[bp+0xc]) and for each entry tests a per-skill byte at record +0x451c (skills[0]), +0x4526, +0x452d (skill sub-blocks) against 0, building '1'/'0' display columns into scratch words 0x57fe/0x5812/0x5820. No spell-table or +0x4570 access occurs there. The actual known-spell read is the bitset membership at 0x318a/0xe34b documented above. (The character-record-spells-and-gaps.json conclusion that there are no spell bitmaps in +0x142..+0x167 remains correct — those are skill/derived-stat bytes; the spell bitset lives at +0x188, a different region, and IS a bitmap.)

evidence.details: wpcvw 0x982f loop: bx=[bp+0x6]; si=[bp-0x2]; cmp byte [bx+si],0x31 ('1'); if not, ax=0x1b0*[bp+0x4]+si; cmp byte [bx+0x451c],0 -> set 1/0; store [si+0x57fe]. Two more identical blocks at 0x4526 (->0x5812) and 0x452d (->0x5820). +0x451c is skills[0] (skills array +0x134..+0x151 per pcfile.ts). No +0xde/+0x4570 references. Therefore 0x982f is the skills render, not the spell-known check.

symbol_map: char_record.knownSpellBitset = record+0x188 (abs DGROUP 0x4570 slot0; slot N = 0x1b0*N+0x4570) — 20-byte field, used as an 11-byte (82-spell) per-spell-id bitset; bit i = spell-table index i known
wpcvw_spellbook_per_school_list = wpcvw.ovr 0x318a (filters 82 spell-table entries by school==sel AND bitset(record+0x4570, idx))
wpcvw_spellbook_sublist_render = wpcvw.ovr 0x31e5 (prints msg 0xfa0+idx per listed known spell; cost from spell-table [idx*6+0xe0])

port_impact.schema_fix: packages/data/src/schemas/pcfile.ts + character.ts: `spellSlotsKnown` (20 bytes @ +0x188) is NOT a per-school count array — it is a per-spell-id BITSET. Rename to e.g. `knownSpellBitset` and document: spell index i known iff (field[i>>3] >> (i&7)) & 1, i in 0..81 over the 82-entry spell table.
port_impact.decoder: To list a character's known spells per school: for i in 0..81: if bit i set in field, look up spell-table[i].school and group. The camp/char-view SPELL viewer shows, per school cell, the known spells of that school; cost shown = spell-table[i] cost byte (entry+0x2); affordability tint = mana_by_school[school] (record +0x4410) vs cost; MODE==0 browse spends nothing.
port_impact.correction: Remove/replace the wpcvw-spell-action.json + character-record-spells-and-gaps.json claim that spell knowledge is read at 0x982f (that is the SKILLS render). The known-spell source is the +0x188 bitset, read via the 0x318a/0xe34b membership test.

unresolved: Whether bytes +0x193..+0x19b (the 9 spare bitset bytes beyond the 11 needed for 82 spells) are ever used — they are zero for the stock roster. If the engine ever indexes spell ids >= 88 they would matter, but the table is fixed at 82; likely permanently spare.

Exact affordability tint semantics (0xdf85 highlight when mana<cost vs 0xc041 otherwise) — branch direction is clear; the on-screen color meaning (which is 'can afford') should be eyeballed against an engine framebuffer of the camp SPELL viewer for a low-mana caster. Marked in cost-power-source comparator_note.

Live MCP drive of camp REVIEW MEMBER->SPELL was not performed this pass (dosbox_live_* tools were not loadable in this subagent context); verification rests on direct decode of the committed pcfile.dbs + static disasm, which is internally consistent (every set bit = a level-1 spell in the char's own book). A DOSBox confirm that the rendered sublist names match the decoded indices would raise the picker-render claim from high to certain.
